summary:
益華電腦本季 EPS 超預期4%，營收年增18.7%，EDA 與 AI 晶片設計需求強勁。
• EPS 1.96 美元，較預估1.89超出3.98%。
• 營收1.47億美元（B級），年增18.66%維持高成長。
• AI 與高效運算晶片設計需求推動 EDA 工具採用。
• 經常性收入與訂閱模式提供高能見度。
ai_view:
訊號正面：EPS 超預期且營收年增近19%，反映 AI 晶片設計浪潮對 EDA 工具的結構性需求。Cadence 與 Synopsys 雙寡頭格局穩固，訂閱模式能見度高。短期股價受惠 AI 主題，但93倍本益比已充分反映高成長，任何指引下修都可能引發劇烈波動。中期看 AI、Chiplet 與系統設計（SDA）滲透。追蹤指標：營收年增、訂單背書、AI 相關產品貢獻與營業利潤率。

需留意：本益比93.04極高，估值對成長放緩高度敏感。；半導體資本支出循環性風險。；中國出口管制可能影響部分客戶營收。

summary_en:
Cadence beat EPS by 4% with 18.7% revenue growth, on strong EDA and AI chip-design demand.
• EPS of $1.96 beat the $1.89 estimate by 3.98%.
• Revenue of $1.47B grew a strong 18.66% year over year.
• AI and high-performance compute chip design drive EDA adoption.
• Recurring revenue and subscription model provide high visibility.

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: an EPS beat with ~19% revenue growth reflects structural EDA demand from the AI chip-design wave. The Cadence-Synopsys duopoly is entrenched, and the subscription model offers high visibility. Near-term the stock benefits from the AI theme, but a 93x P/E fully prices in high growth, so any guidance cut could trigger sharp moves. Mid-term watch AI, chiplet, and system-design (SDA) penetration. Track revenue growth, backlog, AI-product contribution, and operating margin.

Watch：A very high P/E of 93.04 is highly sensitive to slowing growth.; Semiconductor capex cyclicality poses risks.; China export controls could affect some customer revenue.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 較預估高出3.98%，營收年增18.66%動能強勁。
